lessons.title: Unit 9: Social Issues - Core Knowledge
lessons.summary:
1. Vocabulary (Contemporary Social Challenges):

  • Peer & Youth Problems: peer pressure (áp lực đồng trang lứa), bullying (bắt nạt học đường), cyberbullying (bắt nạt trên mạng / không gian số), body shaming (chê bai ngoại hình), depression (trầm cảm), anxiety (lo âu), academic pressure (áp lực thành tích học tập).
  • Societal Problems: poverty (đói nghèo), homelessness (vô gia cư), crime rate (tỷ lệ tội phạm), inequality (bất bình đẳng), overpopulation (quá tải dân số), substance abuse (lạm dụng chất gây nghiện).
  • Actions & Advocacy: stand up to / stand up for (đứng lên bảo vệ / đấu tranh chống lại), raise awareness (nâng cao nhận thức cộng đồng), campaign (chiến dịch), empathy (sự thấu cảm), counseling (tư vấn tâm lý).

2. Pronunciation: Intonation in choice questions

  • Trong câu hỏi lựa chọn (Choice questions có từ nối or):
    • Lên giọng (rising intonation ↗) ở (các) lựa chọn đầu tiên.
    • Xuống giọng (falling intonation ↘) ở lựa chọn cuối cùng để biểu thị danh sách lựa chọn đã kết thúc.
    • Ví dụ: Are you concerned about cyberbullying ↗ or academic pressure ↘?

3. Grammar: Linking Words and Phrases

  • Addition (Bổ sung thông tin): In addition, Furthermore, Moreover, Besides, What is more + [Clause].
    Ví dụ: Cyberbullying causes severe emotional trauma. Furthermore, it can lead to chronic depression.
  • Contrast (Tương phản, nhượng bộ): However, Nevertheless, On the contrary, In contrast, On the other hand.
    Ví dụ: Many students feel stressed by peer pressure; however, very few seek professional counseling.
  • Cause and Result (Nguyên nhân - Hệ quả): As a result, Therefore, Consequently, Thus.
    Ví dụ: She was constantly subjected to online harassment. As a result, she decided to delete all social media accounts.
keyPoints: Cyberbullying and body shaming can inflict deep psychological harm on teenagers.
Choice questions rise on earlier options (↗) and fall on the final choice (↘).
Linking adverbs (However, Therefore, Furthermore) connect independent sentences and are followed by a comma.
Standing up for victims of bullying is an ethical responsibility for all students.

examples.problem: Select the appropriate linking word: 'Poverty prevents children from accessing quality schooling. (Furthermore / However), it increases child labor rates.'
examples.solution: 'Furthermore' (both sentences express negative consequences adding to each other).

examples.problem: Mark the intonation pattern: 'Should we launch an anti-bullying workshop or design awareness posters?'
examples.solution: Rise (↗) on 'anti-bullying workshop' and fall (↘) on 'awareness posters'.
